verdict.rationale: Better Stack is an incident, uptime and on-call automation platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations such as escalation policies and monitors is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no native version history, change review or rollback for these automations. The only related items are adjacent building blocks: a Terraform mention and CRUD API endpoints, which would let a user keep configuration in their own git workflow. That is a user-side workaround, not the product's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
